situation.en: You're paying for a few books at a bookstore in Chicago. You'd like to know if there's a student discount. Then you tap your card, and the payment doesn't go through. (Prices and discounts in this scenario are made-up examples.)
situation.he: אתם משלמים על כמה ספרים בחנות ספרים בשיקגו ורוצים לדעת אם יש הנחת סטודנטים. אחר כך אתם מצמידים את הכרטיס, והתשלום לא עובר. (המחירים וההנחות בתרחיש הם דוגמה בלבד.)

goal.en: Ask about a discount, stay calm when your card is declined, find another way to pay and get your receipt.
goal.he: לשאול על הנחה, להישאר רגועים כשהכרטיס נדחה, למצוא דרך אחרת לשלם ולקבל קבלה.

phrases.en: Do you have a student discount?

phrases.note: In the US, 'on sale' means the price is reduced.
In the UK, 'on sale' can just mean 'available to buy'; 'in the sale' means reduced.

phrases.en: Sorry, could you try it one more time?
That's weird. It worked this morning.
Can I try a different card?
Sorry, I'm holding up the line.
Sorry, I'm holding up the queue.
Could I get a receipt, please?
Could you email it to me instead?
phrases.he: אפשר לשלוח לי אותה במייל במקום?

model_dialogue.speaker: partner
model_dialogue.text: Hi there. Did you find everything OK?

model_dialogue.speaker: you
model_dialogue.text: Yes, thanks. Do you have a student discount, by the way?

model_dialogue.speaker: partner
model_dialogue.text: We do, ten percent with a student ID.

model_dialogue.speaker: partner
model_dialogue.text: Perfect. So that's $32.40. Go ahead and tap whenever you're ready.

model_dialogue.speaker: partner
model_dialogue.text: Hmm, it says declined. Do you want to try again?

model_dialogue.speaker: you
model_dialogue.text: That's weird, it worked this morning. Can I insert it instead?

model_dialogue.speaker: partner
model_dialogue.text: Sure, go ahead… No, sorry, still declined.

model_dialogue.speaker: you
model_dialogue.text: Sorry about this. I'll pay in cash, then.

model_dialogue.speaker: partner
model_dialogue.text: No problem at all. Out of forty… here's $7.60. Do you want the receipt in the bag?

model_dialogue.speaker: you
model_dialogue.text: Could you email it to me instead? And no bag, thanks.

model_dialogue.speaker: partner
model_dialogue.text: Sure, just type your email here. Have a good one!

practice.partner: Hi there. Did you find everything OK?

options.text: Why do you ask me this? I'm just buying some books, it's not your business.

feedback.en: It's just a routine, friendly question, not a real request for information. A suspicious answer like this sounds strange and rude.
feedback.he: זו שאלת נימוס שגרתית, לא באמת בקשת מידע. תשובה חשדנית כזו נשמעת מוזרה וגסה.

options.text: Yes, thanks. Do you have a student discount, by the way?

feedback.en: A quick, friendly answer, then your question. 'By the way' makes it sound relaxed.
feedback.he: תשובה קצרה ונעימה, ואחריה השאלה שלכם. by the way נותן לזה טון רגוע.

options.text: Yes, I found everything, thank you. I want to ask you something: do you have a student discount?

feedback.en: Correct and polite, but a bit long. You can skip 'I want to ask you something' and just ask: 'Do you have a student discount, by the way?'
feedback.he: נכון ומנומס, אבל קצת ארוך. אפשר לוותר על I want to ask you something ופשוט לשאול: Do you have a student discount, by the way?

model_replies: Yes, thanks. Do you have a student discount, by the way?
Yes, thank you. Is there a student discount?

practice.partner: We do, ten percent with a student ID. Do you have one with you?

options.text: Yes, I have it. Here is my student identity card.

feedback.en: Correct, but formal. People just say 'student ID' (US) or 'student card' (UK).
feedback.he: נכון, אבל רשמי. אומרים פשוט student ID (ארה״ב) או student card (בריטניה).

feedback.en: Natural and quick: the cashier can see what you're handing over.
feedback.he: טבעי ומהיר: הקופאי רואה מה אתם מגישים.

options.text: No, but I am student, believe me.

feedback.en: Missing 'a' ('I'm a student'), and asking them to just believe you puts the cashier in an awkward position.
feedback.he: חסר a (I'm a student), ולבקש מהקופאי פשוט להאמין לכם מעמיד אותו במצב לא נעים.

practice.partner: Hmm, it says declined. Do you want to try again?

options.text: Your machine is broken. My card is fine, I used it this morning. Try again.

feedback.en: Blaming their card machine and telling the cashier what to do sounds rude, and the problem is often with your bank. Stay calm and suggest a solution.
feedback.he: להאשים את מכשיר התשלום של החנות ולהגיד לקופאי מה לעשות נשמע גס, והבעיה היא לעיתים קרובות בבנק שלכם. הישארו רגועים והציעו פתרון.

feedback.en: Understandable, but abrupt. 'Sure, let me try again' sounds friendlier.
feedback.he: מובן, אבל חד. Sure, let me try again נשמע נעים יותר.

options.text: That's weird, it worked this morning. Can I insert it instead?

feedback.en: You stay calm, don't blame anyone ('That's weird…') and suggest a solution.
feedback.he: נשארים רגועים, לא מאשימים אף אחד (That's weird...) ומציעים פתרון.

model_replies: That's weird, it worked this morning. Can I insert it instead?

options.text: Sorry about this. I'll pay in cash, then.

feedback.en: A short apology for the delay plus a quick solution. Very natural.
feedback.he: התנצלות קצרה על העיכוב ופתרון מהיר. טבעי מאוד.

feedback.en: Questions need a helping verb: 'What should I do now?' Better still, suggest another way to pay.
feedback.he: בשאלה צריך פועל עזר: What should I do now? ועוד יותר טוב להציע דרך תשלום אחרת.

options.text: I'm very sorry. I have some cash in my bag. I will pay with the cash, OK?

feedback.en: Polite, but stiff, and 'the cash' sounds odd. 'I'll pay in cash, then' is shorter and more natural.
feedback.he: מנומס, אבל נוקשה, ו-the cash נשמע מוזר. I'll pay in cash, then קצר וטבעי יותר.

model_replies: Sorry about this. I'll pay in cash, then.
Sorry! Can I try a different card?

practice.partner: Here's your change. Do you want the receipt in the bag?

feedback.en: Understandable, but too clipped. Make it a request: 'Could you email it to me?'
feedback.he: מובן, אבל קטוע מדי. עדיף לנסח כבקשה: Could you email it to me?

options.text: Could you email it to me instead? And no bag, thanks.

feedback.en: Polite request plus a quick 'no bag, thanks'. Exactly how people say it.
feedback.he: בקשה מנומסת ו-no bag, thanks קצר. בדיוק כמו שאומרים את זה.

options.text: I don't need. Give me the check.

feedback.en: 'Check' is the bill at a restaurant (US), not a receipt, and 'I don't need' needs an object: 'I don't need one'.
feedback.he: check זה החשבון במסעדה (בארה״ב), לא קבלה. וגם אחרי I don't need צריך מושא: I don't need one.

model_replies: Could you email it to me instead? And no bag, thanks.
In the bag is fine, thanks.

roleplay.persona: Marcus, a cashier at a busy bookstore in Chicago. Easygoing and patient, he likes chatting about the books people buy, but there's a long line behind the learner.
roleplay.complication: The learner's card is declined twice, and the store's card reader won't accept the learner's second idea, so they need another solution (cash, another card, or putting a book back). The student discount only applies with a valid student ID, and Marcus asks to see it.
roleplay.opening_line: Hi there! Did you find everything OK today?

culture.en: In most US states, the price on the shelf doesn't include sales tax. It's added at the register, so the total is often a little higher than you expect.
culture.he: ברוב מדינות ארה״ב המחיר על המדף לא כולל מס מכירה. המס מתווסף בקופה, ולכן הסכום הסופי לרוב קצת גבוה ממה שציפיתם.

culture.en: If your card is declined abroad, your bank may have blocked the payment as a security check. Check your banking app or call the bank, and carry a backup way to pay.
culture.he: אם הכרטיס נדחה בחו״ל, ייתכן שהבנק חסם את העסקה כבדיקת אבטחה. כדאי לבדוק באפליקציה של הבנק או להתקשר אליו, ותמיד להחזיק אמצעי תשלום נוסף.

culture.en: Cashiers often ask 'Did you find everything OK?' or 'How's your day going?' A short, friendly answer is all they expect.
culture.he: קופאים שואלים הרבה פעמים Did you find everything OK? או How's your day going? מצפים רק לתשובה קצרה ונעימה.

variants.note: Both mean the price is reduced.
